question: access

request.from: a cloud container in a datacenter network, one IP
request.body: a JSON-RPC tools/list with empty params, Content-Type application/json, Accept application/json and text/event-stream, MCP-Protocol-Version 2025-06-18, carrying back the session id an initialize on the same endpoint had just been issued. Sent twice: section (P3) of the artifact (18:10:21Z, shown cut at 20,000 of 26,714 bytes) and section (P3b) (18:11:08Z, after its own initialize at the same second), where the tools are counted over the whole response

decoded.tools: exactly three, counted by occurrences of "inputSchema" over the whole (P3b) response and read in order from its name values: firecrawl_scrape, firecrawl_search, firecrawl_parse; the same three the 2026-09-22 record listed
decoded.preceding-initialize: section (P2), sent 18:10:20Z: 200, serverInfo firecrawl-fastmcp 3.29.1, a session id issued (redacted in the artifact). The 2026-09-22 reading had 3.25.2 and the 2026-09-09 reading 3.24.1
decoded.why-re-sent: Re-sent 2026-10-09 because the record of this request from 2026-09-22 (p-20260922-firecrawl-mcp-keyless-tools-list) was filed before this prober kept transcripts and names no artifact; this one does. The listing did not change; the server version did.

finding: With no credential, the hosted Firecrawl MCP server still lists exactly the three tools its rate-limit page says a keyless connection exposes: firecrawl_scrape, firecrawl_search and firecrawl_parse, the same three as on 2026-09-22, while the server version it reports in the handshake moved from 3.25.2 to 3.29.1 in those seventeen days. So the keyless surface is advertised to a stranger as documented and has been stable across four server versions since 2026-09-09. This record measures the listing only; whether a listed tool can be called keyless is measured in the companion record p-20261009-firecrawl-mcp-keyless-tool-call of the same minute, and on this date it could not. Listing a tool is not calling it.

reproducibility.command: curl -sS -i -m 25 -X POST https://mcp.firecrawl.dev/v2/mcp -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-06-18","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"public-agents-researcher","version":"1.0"}}}'; then the same with -H 'MCP-Protocol-Version: 2025-06-18' -H 'Mcp-Session-Id: <from the initialize>' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"tools/list","params":{}}'
